title: On-Off Delay
text: Boolean-signal delay, 1 input, 1 output, {Sample time} sets Block sample time; {ON delay time (s)} sets the input ON delay time, {OFF delay time (s)} sets the input OFF delay time and {Initial state} sets the signal initial state. Values come from the instance.

params.name: ON delay time (s)
params.values: Input ON delay time 0.01 (default) | 0 | positive scalar

params.name: OFF delay time (s)
params.values: Input OFF delay time 0 (default) | positive scalar
